_comment: Structure-corrected variant of the 74-case benchmark (python3 -m pyleos bench full --corrected). Each listed case is scored on the named run, whose structure replaces one marked wrong in cases/STRUCTURES.tsv; reference answers are unchanged. The golden table results/bench74_golden.tsv keeps the archived runs. Cases marked wrong but not listed here have no well-defined corrected structure: rhcl_co__p_c6h5_3_2 (the deposited crystal contains SO2) and AuClB_C6H5_3_P_C6H5_3_2 (transcription corrupted, no reference).

v1_mol/CO.why: the archived cell holds two O=C-C=O molecules; alpha-CO, Materials Project mp-11875

v1_oxide/li2o2.why: the archived input put both Li on one site (scaled Cartesian coordinates); Foppl Li2O2, COD 1514084, computed for the homonuclear test set

v1_oxide/re2.why: the archived input placed the two Re 4.8 A apart (scaled Cartesian coordinates); the intended 2.40 A dimer

v1_oxide/ti2o3.why: rutile TiO2 with one O removed; corundum type, COD 9008082

v1_oxide/ce2o3.why: idealised hand-built cell; A-type Ce2O3, Materials Project mp-2721

v1_oxide/na2cro4.why: isolated unrelaxed cluster; Na2CrO4 Cmcm, COD 2107101
